frequency_question: How often does a federal department revoke the recognition of a major, long-standing accrediting agency?
membership_rule: Includes federal departments (like the Dept of Education) and their oversight of accrediting agencies (like the ABA, regional accreditors, or professional boards). Excludes minor administrative sanctions or temporary suspensions.
provenance_note: claims 60 cases from only 2 named (30.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: Only major revocations counted; many agencies have existed for decades without revocation.
known_gaps: Some minor agencies may have dissolved or merged, which could be interpreted as loss of status.
skeleton: Total number of recognized accrediting agencies (approx 60) over 46 years, identifying instances of full revocation.
validity_reason: Regulatory norms regarding accreditation oversight are stable over 2-4 year cycles.
